body:
Full-codebase review, cross-client finding. Verified.

The web client asks `GET /registration-status` on the login page and, on a closed instance, disables the register toggle and says "Registration is disabled on this server." (translated in all nine locales). The Android client has no such call — the endpoint is absent from its Api interface — and always offers the register toggle, with no `login_registration_disabled` string anywhere in res/values. An Android user on a closed instance fills in the whole form and only then gets `403 registration_disabled`.

Fix direction: add the call and the up-front message to Android, with the string in all nine locales paired to the web's English.
title: Android never asks whether registration is open
